messages:
anya: Heads-up — folks building per-route saved queries: are we comfortable with default telemetry sample rates for model-specific views? I'm seeing weird cost spikes when users switch model-variant filters. Any suggestions?

matt: Hmm — is the spike from extra evals, or because routing is falling back to a more expensive model variant? :thinking_face:

devon: From logs it looks like routing fallback + longer context (users switching variants cause re-runs with full history). Quick snippet:

```
route: /api/generate
model_requested: redwood-x-8b
fallback_chain: [redwood-x-8b, redwood-x-13b-quant]
tokens_per_call: 1200 -> 4200
telemetry_sample_rate: 1.0
```

simone: Proposal: when a saved query pins a model variant we should default telemetry sample_rate to 0.05 for that view and show a small "sampled telemetry" badge in the console. Also surface an "estimated extra cost" tooltip when switching variants.

devon: That requires a backing API change — savedquery metadata needs to accept a telemetry override. Right now /savedqueries v1 has no sampling fields. Something like:

PATCH /api/savedqueries/:id
{ telemetry_override: { sample_rate: 0.05 } }

will do the trick.

matt: I like it. Add to rollout checklist: canary at 10% of users + a console banner for sampled state. UI should show exact sample pct: "Telemetry sampled (5%)" so engineers understand the delta.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: prod-deploy started: savedquery-telemetry-flag v1 -> canary 10% :rocket:

simone: Also thinking: gate the override so it only applies to routes above X qps or routes marked "prod" — we don't want to under-sample dev/test tenants.

devon: I'll draft a tiny API spec and a PR. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/789 — includes schema + migration for savedquery metadata.

anya: Perfect. Assigning simone for UX mocks and matt for rollout steps. Can we add a console telemetry chart for sampled vs unsampled counts in the route inspector? That will help validate quality.

matt: Yep. I'll add an endpoint for sampled telemetry summary and a small per-route card in the inspector.

anya: Thanks team — let's sync tomorrow after PR lands. :pray:
